description: Progress of Civgraph's sources, elections and maps, as shown on /pages/status.html. Each total states its basis. Built by scripts/build-status.mjs; generatedAt is when a figure last changed.

sources.name: The Belfast Gazette

known.basis: The Gazette numbers its Belfast issues consecutively from the first, in 1921; about 9,400 have been published. The figure is the issue range Civgraph's crawler is set to cover, kept by hand.

stages.label: Read for election and boundary notices

facts: Downloaded so far: issues 1 to 1,313; 25 of them have no copy online.
Notices found so far: 142 boundary notices and 21 election notices, in issues 1 to 436.
Cited on the site counts the different issues that map and election records cite.
sources.note: Issues are downloaded oldest first, so the early decades are done first.

sources.name: Census of Northern Ireland reports, 1926–1981
sources.publisher: General Register Office for Northern Ireland

known.basis: The seven censuses taken in Northern Ireland between 1926 and 1981.

sources.name: Census of Ireland reports, 1821–1911
sources.publisher: Census Commissioners for Ireland (via the Central Statistics Office's historical reports)
sources.licence: Public domain (Crown copyright expired); CSO copies CC BY 4.0

known.basis: The ten censuses of Ireland taken before partition, 1821 to 1911.

sources.name: Open Data NI

known.basis: The number of datasets the Open Data NI catalogue lists, read from its CKAN API when the snapshot was taken.

stages.label: Used by a map on the site

facts: The map catalogue also links to 6 Open Data NI datasets that are no longer listed.
sources.note: Most datasets are statistics or registers rather than maps, so only some will ever be map layers.

sources.name: Northern Ireland legislation on boundaries and elections

known.basis: Acts, Orders and Statutory Rules for Northern Ireland on legislation.gov.uk whose titles name boundaries, electoral areas, constituencies, wards or elections (a title search, so it misses some), together with any further items the site cites.

facts: 186 found by the title search, and 3 more that the site cites.
sources.note: Many older boundary orders (extensions of towns, for example) are not on legislation.gov.uk at all; the site cites those from the Belfast Gazette instead.

sources.name: PRONI eCatalogue
sources.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland

known.basis: The records Civgraph's copy of the eCatalogue found; PRONI does not publish a total.

facts: A date is read from a record's own date field or description; records with no date at all stay undated.
sources.note: Records are catalogue descriptions only; the documents themselves are at PRONI.

sources.name: Northern Ireland Assembly Register of Members' Interests

known.basis: The register editions and pages listed on the Assembly's current and archived register-of-interests pages.

facts: 75,908 interest entries read from them, 8,289 once repeated entries across editions are merged.

elections.name: Northern Ireland councils before 1973
elections.about: Councils elected before the 1973 reorganisation: county boroughs, boroughs, urban and rural district councils and county councils. No complete list of their elections exists yet, so each bar counts rounds (one council's election on one date) against the known rounds so far: the rounds filed on the site plus rounds documented as not held.
